race.comment: GALANT KNIGHT (1) resumes for his second campaign. He won on debut at Werribee, struggling next time out at Pakenham when in the market without much luck. He's been given time to mature and finds a winnable race first time out. ATAEGINA (6) doesn't win out of turn but ran a good race last time out at Seymour when finding an in-form horse a shade too strong. She's fresh for this but can be charging late. POMAH (9) didn't fire last time out at Tatura as a $2.70 chance but had been going well prior and can atone on the quick turnaround. BRUTIFY (8) is racing consistently, not far away as favourite at Wodonga. She can roll forward and figure in the finish.
